name: GBU4J-E3_51
title: 4 A glass-passivated single-phase bridge rectifier, GBU in-line package
summary: The GBU4A to GBU4M are single-phase full-wave bridges of four glass-passivated diodes in the four-lead in-line GBU through-hole package, rated 4.0 A average output with the case on a heatsink and 3.0 A on a printed circuit board. The seven grades run from 50 V to 1000 V repetitive peak reverse voltage and share every other figure: 150 A surge, 1.0 V forward drop per diode at 4.0 A, 5 µA leakage at 25 °C and a 150 °C junction limit. The GBU4J is the 600 V grade.

notes: Only the voltage ratings differ between grades; current, surge, forward, leakage, capacitance and thermal figures are common to all seven.
The -E3 suffix is RoHS-compliant, commercial grade. The -M3 suffix is halogen-free as well as RoHS-compliant, commercial grade.
The number after the slash is the packing code: /45 is a tube of 20, /51 a paper tray of 250.

operation.text: Four diodes make one full-wave bridge. Each ~ lead is joined to the anode of a diode going to + and the cathode of a diode coming from -. An AC voltage between the two ~ leads comes out rectified between + and -.

With the case on a 4.0 cm x 4.0 cm x 0.15 cm aluminium plate, the full 4.0 A average holds to a case temperature of 100 °C and falls in a straight line to zero at 150 °C. Mounted on a PCB with 12 mm x 12 mm copper pads and 9.5 mm leads, 3.0 A holds to an ambient of 40 °C, falling in a straight line to zero at 150 °C. Both are for a 60 Hz resistive or inductive load.

One cycle of 60 Hz surge on top of rated load may peak at 150 A per diode with the junction starting at its maximum. Repeated cycles lower the allowed peak: about 94 A at 7 cycles, 70 A at 20 cycles and 39 A at 100 cycles. The fusing rating for less than 8.3 ms is 93 A2s.

Junction to case is 4.2 °C/W typical with the case on an aluminium plate heatsink; junction to ambient is 22 °C/W typical in free air on a PCB with 12 mm x 12 mm copper pads and 9.5 mm leads. The transient thermal impedance rises from about 0.74 °C/W at 10 ms to about 14 °C/W at 100 s.
The body has a slotted mounting hole. The tightening torque limit is 10 cm-kg (8.8 inch-lbs); 5.7 cm-kg (5 inch-lbs) is the recommended value. The case insulation withstands 1500 VRMS.

The diodes are glass passivated. The moulded case is rated UL 94 V-0 and is UL recognised under file E54214. The leads are matte tin, solderable to J-STD-002 and JESD 22-B102, and pass JESD 201 class 1A whisker testing in both E3 and M3 versions. A solder dip of up to 275 °C for 10 s per JESD 22-B106 is allowed.
A general-purpose full-wave bridge for AC-to-DC rectification; the named applications are monitors, televisions, printers, switch-mode power supplies, adapters, audio equipment and home appliances.
